name: Peroneal Tendinopathy
definition: Load-related pain and dysfunction of the peroneal/fibularis tendons along the lateral ankle and foot, sometimes associated with instability or cavovarus mechanics.

typical: Symptoms with running or uneven ground

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI evaluates tear, subluxation or refractory symptoms.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs assess bony alignment or fracture.

amber: Persistent tear or recurrent tendon dislocation may need surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-Snayu Vata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Load-related pain and dysfunction of the peroneal/fibularis tendons along the lateral ankle and foot, sometimes associated with instability or cavovarus mechanics.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
